items.title: Unit 5 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: Two bees play in the sea. I like this leaf! I like this wave! I see a key. I see money. I see candy. I see... feet!
items.why: In “Bees in the Sea”, you hear: feet! The missing word is “feet”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
